cta.desc: Transform your organization's environmental impact with intelligent tracking, beautiful insights, and actionable sustainability reports.

customTargets.title: Custom Targets
customTargets.subtitle: Set your sustainability goals
customTargets.description: Create and manage custom emission reduction targets tailored to your organization's sustainability objectives.

materiality.title: Materiality Engine
materiality.subtitle: Assess material sustainability topics
materiality.description: Identify and prioritize the most important environmental, social, and governance topics for your organization.

department.title: Organization Department

department.description: Set up and manage departments within your organization to better organize and track emissions data.

userManagement.title: User Management

mobile.description: Monitor emissions from company vehicles, delivery trucks, and transportation fleets. Essential for logistics companies and organizations with vehicle fleets.
